description: Turn any photo into a perfect profile picture: square center-crop with zoom, circle or square shape, a colored ring, and export at 256, 512 or 1024 px.

faqs.a: Move the zoom slider right to crop tighter on your face, or left to include more of the photo. The crop always stays centered.
faqs.q: How do I frame my face?

faqs.a: Yes — set the ring width to 0 and it disappears entirely, leaving just your cropped photo.
No. Your photo is cropped and drawn on a canvas in your browser — it is never uploaded anywhere.

howto: Upload your photo — a live preview appears instantly.
Drag the zoom slider to frame your face the way you like.
Pick circle or square shape, a ring color and ring width.
Choose the export size (256, 512 or 1024 px) and click “Download PNG”.
title: Profile Picture Maker
